column1: # Land use and buildings per hexagon (PLUTO 26v2)
#   lot_area_km2: total tax-lot area in the hexagon
#   lot_coverage: lot area / hexagon land area (the rest is mostly streets)
#   share_residential: share of the hexagon's lot area that is 1-2 family
#   share_mixed: share of the hexagon's lot area that is mixed residential and commercial (04)
#   share_commercial: share of the hexagon's lot area that is commercial and office (05)
#   share_industrial: share of the hexagon's lot area that is industrial and manufacturing (06)
#   share_transport_utility: share of the hexagon's lot area that is transportation and utility: airports
#   share_institution: share of the hexagon's lot area that is public facilities and institutions: schools
#   share_open_space: share of the hexagon's lot area that is open space and outdoor recreation: parks
#   share_parking: share of the hexagon's lot area that is parking facilities (10)
#   share_vacant: share of the hexagon's lot area that is vacant land (11)
#   share_cemetery: share of the hexagon's lot area that is cemeteries (building class Z8)
#   share_airport: share of the hexagon's lot area that is airports (building class T1)

#   share_unbuilt_unlivable: share of the hexagon's lot area that is land nobody lives on: open space + cemeteries + airports + transport/utility lots that have no housing and almost no buildings (rail yards
#   res_units_per_km2: residential units per km² of land
#   com_floor_m2: commercial floor area (office + retail + other commercial)
#   industrial_floor_m2: factory and industrial floor area
#   built_far: floor area / lot area (built density; Midtown towers are 10+)
#   median_year_built: median year built of lots with a building (point-assigned lots only)

column2: 000 sq ft are assigned by center point; larger lots are split by outline overlap.

column3: so streets don't count; they can overlap (cemetery and airport are subsets of other land uses). Empty when a hexagon has no lots.

column1: #   PLUTO areas are in square feet in the source and converted to m² here.
